text:
You're not failing with women. You're failing your mission.

Call it the attention drain. Every text answered, every plan made, every night spent on her instead of the work. That is what kills momentum.

There are seasons where you go quiet. No dating. No texting. Just building. Stacking. That is not weakness. That is the correct move.

The man with a real mission does not chase. He builds until he has something worth coming back to.

No mission, no spine, no future. Pick one thing and refuse to stop.
caption:
The biggest self improvement mistake men make is building for attraction when they should build for the mission. Fix that first.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
